steps.text: Check timestamps, camera moves and scene text before reuse.

good: You need structured JSON rather than just a paragraph.
You want model presets and supported social video links.
consider: You expect every private or restricted link to work.
You need a fixed free allowance: credit descriptions differ across official sections.

faq.a: The site offers starter credits and paid plans. Its homepage and dedicated pricing page use different credit descriptions, so confirm the current balance and limits in the account interface.

faq.q: Does it accept YouTube and TikTok links?
faq.a: The public interface advertises supported YouTube and TikTok URLs as well as uploads. Availability can depend on the source video’s access restrictions; we did not test extraction.
Yes. The official product page describes structured JSON alongside descriptive text for generative workflows.

faq.q: Are the example scenes tested results?
faq.a: No. The scene shown on the public landing page is a product demonstration, not a ToolFavor test using an uploaded video.
The site links to separate video-generation tools. Prompt extraction and video generation are different actions; check the chosen tool’s credit cost.
